name: Environmental Science Communication
description: This course develops core competencies in science communication, training students to analyze, adapt, and produce effective scientific messaging across multiple mediums (digital, print, oral) for diverse audiences (public, policymakers, educators). Through a combination of theoretical frameworks and hands-on practice, students will master format selection, audience-tailoring techniques, ethical communication principles, and critical evaluation of science communication outputs.
